title: Introduce reservation derater and utilization-correlation service
author: Asha Patel
description:
Motivation: Dedicated fleets occasionally overshoot soft reservation budgets when an inbound surge is followed by a long tail of small requests. This PR introduces a lightweight reservation derater and a utilization-correlation service that together make small, bounded adjustments to per-tenant reservations based on short-term utilization fingerprints and cross-tenant correlation signals.

Goals (high level):
- Prevent sustained oversubscription following transient surges by applying gentle, time-decayed reservation derates.
- Improve observability by correlating fleet-level utilization spikes with reservation adjustments, enabling post-mortem attribution and tuning.
- Keep changes safe and conservative: derates are capped and annotated so any downstream admission control can opt-out.

What this PR contains (single-string summary):
- reservation-derater microservice (go) that subscribes to the utilization-rollup topic, computes a derate score per tenant using an exponential decay window, and emits signed reservation-adjustment events. Derates are piecewise-linear, capped at 30% and auto-recovered over a configurable cooldown window.
- utilization-correlation pipeline additions (rust) that compute pairwise correlation sketches between tenants and emit a daily correlation report used by SRE and pricing.
- API surface: new admin endpoint POST /admin/derate-simulate (console-only) and /admin/derate-apply (feature-flagged) with audit headers.
- Integration with gateway admission: small admission hook that prefers to honor explicit reservation-adjustment events and logs a deterministic reason for each decision for traceability.
- Telemetry: new metrics (derater.applied_count, derater.recovery_rate_seconds, derater.max_derate_applied, utilcorr.pair_samp_count) and a Grafana dashboard JSON (dashboards/derater-utilcorr.json).
- Safety: feature flag gate, Linear tasks linked in metadata (ENG-8423, ENG-9031), and unit+integration test coverage.

release_notes: Introduces a feature-flagged reservation derater to reduce sustained oversubscription after bursts, plus utilization-correlation telemetry and dashboard. Derates are conservative (default cap 30%) and opt-in via admim console. Rollout: gradual, controlled by feature flag and canary harness.
